info.description:
This is a comprehensive HR Management System API built with Go and Gin framework.
It provides endpoints for managing employees, leave requests, companies, departments, and more.
info.title: Kartezya HR Management System API

post.description: Authenticate user with email and password

get.description: Get the profile of the authenticated user
Get paginated list of companies with sorting (Admin only)
Get simplified list of companies for dropdown/lookup (Admin only)
Get all departments for a specific company (Admin only)
Get a specific company by ID (Admin only)

put.description: Update a company by ID (Admin only)

delete.description: Delete a company by ID (Admin only)

get.description: Get all departments for a specific company (Admin only)
Get simplified list of departments for a specific company (Admin only)
Get all departments with pagination (Admin only)
Get a specific department by ID (Admin only)

put.description: Update a department by ID (Admin only)

delete.description: Delete a department by ID (Admin only)

get.description: Get paginated list of all employees (Admin only)
Get the profile of the authenticated employee
Get employee details by ID (Admin only)

put.description: Update employee details by ID (Admin or own profile)

get.description: Get paginated list of job positions with sorting (Admin only)

post.description: Create a new job position (Admin only)

get.description: Get simplified list of job positions for dropdown/lookup (Admin only)
Get a specific job position by ID (Admin only)

put.description: Update a job position by ID (Admin only)

delete.description: Delete a job position by ID (Admin only)

post.description: Create a new leave type (Admin only)

get.description: Get paginated leave balances for the authenticated employee
Get paginated list of all leave requests (Admin only)

post.description: Create a new leave request (Employee for own, Admin for any)

get.description: Get paginated leave requests for the authenticated employee
Get a specific leave request by ID (Admin only)

put.description: Update a leave request by ID (Employee for own, Admin for any)

post.description: Approve a leave request by ID (Admin only)
Cancel a leave request by ID (Employee for own, Admin for any)
Reject a leave request by ID (Admin only)

get.description: Get paginated list of leave types (Admin only)
Get simplified list of leave types for dropdown/lookup
Get a specific leave type by ID (Admin only)

put.description: Update a leave type by ID (Admin only)

delete.description: Delete a leave type by ID (Admin only)

get.description: Get paginated list of all work information (Admin only)

post.description: Create work information for an employee (Admin only)

get.description: Get work information for the authenticated employee
Get specific work information by ID

put.description: Update work information by ID (Admin only)

delete.description: Delete work information by ID (Admin only)
